text:
Samir (Sales): quick update — Acme wants to finish POC + sign MSA/DPA by end of week. They pushed a couple of redlines in the MSA and asked for SLA tweaks. Need legal + finance to align so we can route signature.
Maria G (Legal): which redlines specifically? can you paste the annotated doc? :eyes:
Samir (Sales): uploaded here ^ link: https://drive.company/Acme/msa-redlines
Samir (Sales): summary: 1) 30-day termination for convenience -> they want 60 2) indemnity cap carveouts for open-source 3) data residency clause for EU data 4) SLA uptime from 99.9% -> 99.95% and credits language changed 5) DPA: subprocessors list + additional audit rights
Devon P (Solutions): on the POC side they want an extended trial (30d), 2 dedicated instances, and a success criteria doc we agreed on. also asked if usage during POC is billable — they expect no charge for trial credits.
Aqib R (Finance): billing ask: they will raise a PO, prefer Net45. We need to confirm invoice amount if we convert POC to paid pilot. what's the expected orderform value?
Samir (Sales): pilot estimate is ~$48,000 for 3 months (2 instances + support). If POC converts to committed Dedicated, orderform will be larger. We need Finance to confirm whether we can accept Net45 and prepay exceptions.
Maria G (Legal): high-level legal stance: 1) 60-day termination is acceptable for enterprise but reduces our churn protections — prefer 30/45. can we compromise 45? 2) indemnity: we can add OSS carveouts but need to limit to direct damages. 3) EU data residency — we can offer region-specific hosting but DPA needs to list subprocessor commitments. 4) SLA: 99.95% is a significant uptick; can offer 99.9% + can add a one-time credit for the pilot, but not change global SLA for hosted product without product/ops signoff.
Jen L (Engineering): for EU residency we can pin workloads to eu-west-1 on Dedicated/private deployments. For Hosted API we can add routing policy but can't guarantee residency for all edge calls. also, 2 dedicated instances for POC is fine as a temporary allocation.
Aqib R (Finance): Net45 ok if Legal signs off and RevOps creates a payment schedule. For pilot credits, finance needs a SKU line so we can zero out invoice. example orderform snippet:
```
LineItems:
- POC Dedicated (30 days): 2 x instance-hour * price = $X
- Support: $Y
- One-time setup: $Z
Credits:
- Trial credit: -$48,000
```
Samir (Sales): can we get Legal to mark up counter-MSA with tracked changes and a short memo of what's negotiable? Acme's legal team is pushing the 60-day termination and SLA clause as must-haves.
Maria G (Legal): will do. I'll draft a counter and flag the non-starters. Also pinging @Devon for SOW alignment and @Aqib on Net terms. Expect draft in ~3 hours.
doc-bot: uploaded: sources/docs/Acme/msa-counter_v2.docx
Devon P (Solutions): I'll attach the success criteria and POC runbook to the counter so legal sees expected scope. small ask: can engineering confirm any data flows requiring external subs?
Jen L (Engineering): no external subs beyond our monitoring provider (Datadog). we'll add that to subprocessor list. no customer data leaves EU region for pinned workloads.
Aqib R (Finance): once counter is ready we'll create a provisional orderform with 'PO pending' line and pre-approved credit note so Sales can share numbers. Samir, send me final SKU list.
Samir (Sales): sending SKU now. also confirm: signature routing — do we need exec sign-off or is Renewals/RevOps allowed to countersign pilot agreements under $100k?
Maria G (Legal): we can allow RevOps to countersign up to $75k. above that requires Legal + VP Sales signoff. For PO acceptance we need billing contact and billing address on the orderform.
Samir (Sales): noted. I'll ask Acme for billing contact and put RevOps on standby. thanks all :thumbsup:
Devon P (Solutions): quick note — if SLA change is a blocker, propose a short-term addendum for the POC only with limited credits. that usually smooths things.
Maria G (Legal): agree. will include a POC addendum template and mark SLA changes as pilot-limited.
Samir (Sales): great — next steps: Maria to upload counter and add memo; Aqib to provision provisional orderform; Devon to attach SOW; Jen to confirm subprocessor statement. aim to get signature route open by EOD Friday.
Jen L (Engineering): ack.
Aqib R (Finance): ack, queueing RevOps after doc ready.
Maria G (Legal): uploading draft now.
doc-bot: uploaded: sources/docs/Acme/msa-counter_v3.docx
Samir (Sales): thanks everyone. I'll update the customer and ask them to sign the POC addendum while we iterate the MSA redlines.
Maria G (Legal): thanks — I left comments on clause 7 (indemnity) and clause 12 (termination).
Samir (Sales): received, forwarding to Acme counsel.
Devon P (Solutions): ping if they want a short call to go over the POC success metrics — can do tomorrow morning.
Samir (Sales): scheduling call for 10am PT tomorrow. invite sent. :calendar:
Maria G (Legal): I'll join to confirm timelines for countersignature.
Jen L (Engineering): I'll join for a quick ops pass.
Samir (Sales): thread closed once signed. will post final signed doc here.
